claim: Forgetting in LLM post-training extends beyond parametric knowledge, with particularly strong drift in robustness and default behavioral preferences.
falsifier: For a given LLM and post-training procedure, measure parametric knowledge retention (e.g., factual recall) alongside robustness (e.g., adversarial input stability) and default behavioral preferences (e.g., output style or safety tendencies) before and after training; the claim predicts that robustness and behavioral preferences will show larger relative drift than parametric knowledge.

conditions: Post-training applied to already aligned models
Evaluation using CapTrack framework across multiple model families, domains, and algorithms
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported model families, domains, and post-training algorithms; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Post-training–Forgetting, including drift principle
